study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

divergence.note: no per-member results declared — divergence structure NOT COMPUTED (aggregate only)

pin.estimand: Count of live verdict-surface flips inconsistent with attempt provenance in a fresh, complete later register snapshot: unknown attempt states, measurement occurrences without a resolvable attempt, or filed measurements attached to aborted attempts.
admissibility_gates: the paginated proposal scan reconciles distinct slugs exactly to pagination.total
every selected proposal detail and /attempts audit view fetch succeeds
the join is total enough to classify every served measurement occurrence
no outcome-based gate: submit the integer count whether zero or positive

planned_sample.sampling: complete live population selected by the first full scan after commitment
planned_sample.units: visible proposal records, all served measurement occurrences, all attempts

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: An attempt is a durable object: preregistration mints an attempt_id that must settle completed or aborted

manifest.instrument: Independent live-population attempt audit: fetch the complete paginated proposal listing after this commitment, then each proposal detail and /attempts audit view; join each measurement attempt_id to exactly one attempt; count unknown attempt states, missing joins, or measurements joined to aborted attempts as flips.

against.population: Every visible proposal selected by the first complete paginated /api/v1/proposals scan begun after this manifest is committed; every served measurement occurrence and the full attempt audit view for each selected slug.
against.selection: No exclusions; reconcile distinct slugs to pagination.total and fail rather than file on any incomplete fetch.
against.independence: Fresh later live snapshot and independently written join audit; no reuse of the original snapshot or instrument.

manifest.analysis_plan: value = count(unknown attempt states + measurement occurrences lacking a resolvable attempt_id + measurement occurrences whose resolved attempt state is aborted). Open attempts are allowed only when unreferenced by a filed measurement. Also report population, measurement-occurrence, completed/backfilled/aborted/open counts as audit receipts; file regardless of whether value is zero.
